Each time unit with any model equipped with [EXTRA ATTACKS] weapon fights
Those models: attacks with those weapons on top of any others
Select Weapons step (04.01), each such model must select:
- all its [EXTRA ATTACKS] weapons
- 1 of its other melee weapons, if possible
core/keywords/feel-no-pain/text:
Always written Feel No Pain X+
Each time model with this ability would lose wound
Roll 1D6:
- X+: that wound not lost
core/keywords/fights-first/text:
While all models in unit have this ability: unit is Fights First unit
See Resolve Fights First Combats step, Fight phase (12.04)
core/keywords/firing-deck/text:
Always written Firing Deck X
Timing: your Shooting phase, each time this TRANSPORT selected to shoot
Condition: unit embarked within this TRANSPORT
Result: sequence below
1. Select up to X models embarked within this TRANSPORT (not models whose units already selected to shoot this phase)
2. Per selected model: select 1 of its ranged weapons (not [ONE SHOT] weapons)
3. This TRANSPORT has all selected weapons, besides its other weapons, until it has resolved all its attacks
4. Units embarked within this TRANSPORT: not eligible to shoot until end of turn
core/keywords/harpooned/text:
Timing: this unit declares charge
Condition: enemy MONSTER/VEHICLE unit ≤12" of this unit, hit by attack with this weapon this turn
Result: optionally, both:
- this unit: +2 to charge rolls until end of phase
- that charge move: must finish engaged with that MONSTER/VEHICLE unit
core/keywords/hazardous/text:
Each time unit selected to shoot or to fight, once all its attacks resolved
Hazard rolls (06.03) for that unit: as many as [HAZARDOUS] weapons selected in Select Weapons step
core/keywords/heavy/text:
Timing: your Shooting phase, each attack with [HEAVY] weapon
Condition: attacking unit meets all of these:
- unengaged
- not set up on battlefield this turn
- none of its models moved over 3" this turn
Result: +1 to hit roll
core/keywords/hover/text:

core/keywords/ignores-cover/text:

core/keywords/leader/text:

core/keywords/one-shot/text:
Each [ONE SHOT] weapon: selectable to make attacks once per battle only
Destroyed model returned to unit: its [ONE SHOT] weapons already selected this battle stay unselectable
New unit added to army: all its [ONE SHOT] weapons selectable once per battle

core/keywords/plasma-warhead/text:
Restriction: bearer shoots with this weapon only in your Shooting phase, only if it Remained Stationary this turn and its **Deathstrike Missile** ability was not used this phase for Designate Target or Adjust Target
Timing: bearer shoots with this weapon
Result:
- no target selected
- this weapon's attacks resolved, rolled separately for each unit ≤6" of centre of its Deathstrike Target marker
core/keywords/precision/text:
Timing: attacks with [PRECISION] weapons, start of Allocation Order step (05.03)
Condition: target unit has CHARACTER models visible to any attacking model
Select: active player may pick 1 allocation group holding 1 of those visible CHARACTER models

Duration: until those attacks resolved or that CHARACTER group destroyed, whichever comes first

core/keywords/psychic/text:

- unit embarked within DEDICATED TRANSPORT wholly within your deployment zone, and every model embarked within it has Scouts: that DEDICATED TRANSPORT may make scout move

core/keywords/super-heavy-walker/text:

core/stratagems/Command Re-roll/effect:
That roll re-rolled

Exception: Charge roll re-rolled in full
core/stratagems/Command Re-roll/when:
Any phase
Just after you make a roll for a friendly unit or model, one of:
- Advance roll
- Charge roll
- Damage roll
- Hazard roll
- Hit roll
- Save roll
- Wound roll
- roll setting how many attacks a weapon generates

- each 1: own unit suffers 1 mortal wound
